payload.name: ExtractGeneralPreferenceAlongsideConcreteEvent
payload.description: When a message states a general preference or habitual activity and then gives a specific instance, extract the general statement as a preference and the specific instance as an event.
content: During extraction, when a message contains a general, ongoing preference or habit (e.g., 'we love to discover new places to eat') and also a concrete instance, record the general statement as a separate `preference` memory and the concrete instance as an `event` memory—both are independently durable.

During CRUD, before merging a new specific instance into an existing event memory, check if the originating message also stated a general preference; if that preference is missing from memory, add it (as a new memory or enrichment) so the general fact is not lost.

solves: Construction extraction often drops a general preference or habitual activity when the same utterance also gives a concrete example, leaving memory that only records the specific event. This Skill ensures both the general preference (as `preference`) and the specific event are captured, and that CRUD updates check for the missing general preference. It applies whenever a user states an ongoing interest and a particular instance in the same or later turn.
